g.text: PCA9685 applies only to PWM servos. Smart bus servos require the matching bus transceiver and feedback protocol.

g.desc: PCA9685 applies only to PWM servos. Smart bus servos require the matching bus transceiver and feedback protocol.

g.text: Named nets in both drawings denote the same interface. Bus labels are conceptual cables, not single copper traces.

g.desc: Named nets in both drawings denote the same interface. Bus labels are conceptual cables, not single copper traces.

g.text: T12 also has an OEM gyro. Body IMU + head IMU remain explicit; OEM gyro access and LiDAR protocol are unverified.

g.desc: T12 also has an OEM gyro. Body IMU + head IMU remain explicit; OEM gyro access and LiDAR protocol are unverified.

g.text: Kinect v1 assumed from user: USB 2.0 + libfreenect. Confirm model label and validate depth streaming on the Pi.

g.desc: Kinect v1 assumed from user: USB 2.0 + libfreenect. Confirm model label and validate depth streaming on the Pi.

g.text: Vacuum base with differential drive assumed; NO mecanum wheels. OEM motor control, encoders and safety sensors preferred.

g.desc: Vacuum base with differential drive assumed; NO mecanum wheels. OEM motor control, encoders and safety sensors preferred.

g.text: LiDAR stays on OEM wiring provisionally. Access through documented base API or a model-specific adapter to Pi; do not guess pins.

g.desc: LiDAR stays on OEM wiring provisionally. Access through documented base API or a model-specific adapter to Pi; do not guess pins.

g.text: Two separate IMU bus channels avoid equal-address conflicts. Camera IMU must move with camera; publish separate frames.

g.desc: Two separate IMU bus channels avoid equal-address conflicts. Camera IMU must move with camera; publish separate frames.

g.text: ESP32 shown USB-powered only; do not also inject external 5V without verified power selection/backfeed protection.

g.desc: ESP32 shown USB-powered only; do not also inject external 5V without verified power selection/backfeed protection.
